reason: `Time.at(now)` builds the stubbed Time; the trails clock seam takes a `Temporal.Instant` directly, so there is no `at` constructor to call.
`Time.zone.parse` handles the String arm; `Temporal.Instant.from` parses the ISO string instead.
`to_time` normalizes a Date/DateTime receiver to a Time; the TS arm converts a `Date` to a `Temporal.Instant` via `fromEpochMilliseconds`.
